title: Vanishing Fourier component at fixed support
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$. For an integer $n\ge 0$, let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$ and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}\ n$. If every multi-index whose support is exactly $J$ has Fourier coefficient of $f$ equal to zero, then the Fourier component of $f$ at support $J$ is the zero function.
